pageDescription: Manage your personal token for connecting MCP clients to LeafWiki. The token authenticates as you and grants your permissions.
sectionDescription: Use this token to connect an MCP client to LeafWiki. Each user has at most one token. Tokens expire 90 days after they are created.
emptyHint: Generate a token to connect an MCP client. The token will be shown only once.
actionsDescription: Generate a new token or revoke the existing one. Regenerating replaces the current token.

reveal.title: Your new MCP token
reveal.description: Copy this token now and store it somewhere safe.
reveal.warning: This token is shown only once. You won't be able to see it again after closing this view.

regenerateConfirm.title: Regenerate MCP token?
regenerateConfirm.description: This invalidates your current token. Any MCP client using the old token will stop working until you update it with the new token.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke MCP token?
revokeConfirm.description: This permanently deletes your token. Any MCP client using it will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
